coder_notes: Diet-only intervention (classic ketogenic diet), not a drug; no agents listed. Population is glioblastoma grade 4 plus brain metastases (could also be read as mixed_glioma_gbm_named); coded basket because brain metastases are non-glioma. Trial excluded at S6 either way.
